texts.title: Want the result… without the road?
texts.hook.h1.frame: Eyes closed: your dream came true
texts.hook.h1: Try it: close your eyes for 3 seconds… and picture your dream come true.
texts.hook.h2.frame: Endure the stings… or love them?
texts.hook.h2: Whoever wants honey must endure the bee stings… or love them?
texts.hook.h3.frame: I picture success… and don't move
texts.hook.h3: Every day I picture myself succeeding… and I'm still in the same place.
texts.hook.h4: 21 studies asked: is dreaming enough… or do you need a plan?
texts.hook.h5.frame: Your dream… what's its first step?
texts.hook.h5: The dream on your mind right now… what's its first step?
texts.s1.n1: This is Karim. He has a presentation tomorrow.
texts.s1.l1: They'll applaud… I'll be employee of the month!
texts.s1.l2: Karim, did you open the presentation file?
texts.s1.l3: Not yet… but it'll be amazing!
texts.s1.a3: And you… when you opened your eyes, what did you do?
texts.s1.n2: Let's play it again… this time Karim looks at the obstacle.
texts.s1.l4: If I start putting it off… I'll open the first slide.
texts.s1.l5: Karim, did you open the presentation file?
texts.s1.l6: Still on the first one… but I've started.
texts.book.card: Not what you want… but what you're ready to struggle for.
texts.book.l1: The book says: dreamers don't get there… those who accept the effort do.
texts.book.l2: Like wanting to be a rock star… without the years of practice.
texts.verdict.card: 21 studies: dream, see the obstacle, plan… you reach your goal more
texts.verdict.nuance: But online, with 12,879 students… it didn't raise the number who finished the course.
texts.verdict.l2: In experiments: whoever pictured success as already done… lost energy.
texts.verdict.l3: Whoever saw the effort as a sign of progress… engaged more, right then.
texts.verdict.l4: And in 21 studies: whoever dreamed, looked at the obstacle and planned… reached their goal a little more.
texts.takeaway.l1: Try it: after the dream, name what will hold you back… and the first step. It may help.
texts.share: Send this to someone with a dream… still waiting to start.
